item.title: Patch 1.0.20
item.description:
We've heard a lot of you pointing out that you haven't been getting as many trophies as you should from your kills, and this patch should finally fix that. We hope you're ready to craft those bear rugs!

Please Note: There is a small delay with Mac App Store for this patch, which means that crossplay will not work between Mac App Store players and players on other platforms until it has caught up. As soon as the patch is out on that platform, crossplay should work for everyone again

  • Enemies spawning Out-of-Bounds on Soulbound Threshold.

  • Enforcer clipping through terrain when using some abilities.
